packageRules.description: better-auth 1.7.22+ consumes verifications with an `id ne` filter that @convex-dev/better-auth 0.13.0 rejects (convex/better-auth#479). Hold both packages until convex/better-auth#481 ships.
@tanstack/vue-table v9 removes the v8 table APIs and is not supported by @nuxt/ui yet. Stay on v8 until Nuxt UI ships v9 support.
nuxt-typed-router 4.0.11 was published with unresolved `catalog:` dependencies (prettier, @nuxt/kit, better-sqlite3) and cannot be installed. Skip it until a fixed release is published.
